messages:
Maya: Final check for Optimize v0.9 announce. We need changelog link, docs URL with utm, a single p95 stat and token-cost delta, plus confirmation of SDR routing by EOD.
Sanjay: Changelog merged; will publish permalink after docs go live. PR ref: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/412
Liam: Docs team will publish Optimize guide by Tue 14:00 PT. We'll hand over canonical URL and add ?utm_campaign=optimize_v0.9.
Olivia: Rollout plan: canary in us-west @09:00 PT, 30m observation, then ramp. Canary is public but low capacity.
Maya: Can marketing screenshots be taken from canary? Need to know UX parity.
Olivia: Yes, same UX path; screenshots safe.
Samir: I'll post a p95 screenshot and a 7-day baseline vs v0.9 CSV by Tue 15:00 for design.
Priya: Webinar Thu 10:00 PT. Landing page needs short blurb + CTA. SDR routing requires webhook with "tag":"optimize-launch" and "campaign":"optimize_v0.9" fields.
Sanjay: Confirmed. We'll include campaign and tag exactly as requested and coordinate schema bump with release-bot.
release-bot: Deploy scheduled: service/optimize v0.9 -> canary us-west @ 2025-11-12T09:00:00-08:00; full rollout @ 2025-11-12T09:30:00-08:00. CI: green.
Maya: Thanks. Once docs + changelog URLs are up, post them here with a two-sentence blurb for socials and the exact webhook sample so SDR can validate. We'll schedule the announce for Wed 09:05 PT. :rocket:
